title: Human-Centric Topic Modeling with Goal-Prompted Contrastive Learning and Optimal Transport
subcategory: goal-guided neural topic model (LLM prompting + contrastive learning + optimal transport)
task: Goal-oriented topic discovery from a free-text analytical goal
problem: Coherence-driven topic models give redundant or off-target topics that ignore the analyst's question.
architecture: GCTM-OT: an LLM extracts goal-related phrases per document (goal candidates); LLM text augmentation creates positive pairs; a transformer builds goal-weighted document representations; topic inference with Dirichlet prior matching; semantic-aware contrastive learning; optimal-transport alignment between topic and goal representations.
llm_or_encoder: GPT-3.5-turbo (prompts); RoBERTa and other encoders compared

datasets.name: Bothering
datasets.details: r/whatsbotheringyou posts; 1,483 documents, vocabulary 7,700, average length 56.48

key_results: Goal Similarity: 0.4253 / 0.5100 / 0.4530 on Bothering / TeslaModel3 / AskAcademia, vs best baseline 0.3845 (CAST) / 0.4736 (LLM-ITL) / 0.4104 (LLM-ITL).
Average CP 0.3326 on Bothering vs 0.1214 for LDA; UT 0.9800 at 20 topics on Bothering.
Swapping the prompt LLM changes results (e.g. GPT-4o-mini CP 0.3802 vs DeepSeek-V2.5 0.3276 in the ablation setting).
strengths: Defines a goal-conditioned topic modelling task with goal-alignment metrics.
Large baseline set including recent LLM-assisted models.

limitations.text: Goal metrics use OpenAI embeddings and ground-truth goal candidates built by clustering plus human annotation, so they depend on that annotation.
Small Reddit corpora (1.5k-3.3k documents) and three goals only; NPMI and UCI stay low or negative for all models.
